dedupe_keys.name: aider aerial image dataset for emergency response applications

description: A KIOS research group publishes AIDER, an aerial-image dataset for recognising emergency events. Zenodo supplies a ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The own page describes fire or smoke, flood, collapsed-building or rubble, traffic-accident and normal-image classes. It reports about 500 images for each disaster class and more than 4,000 normal images, collected from online images and videos and manually checked for a centred event. These examples can train or test image classifiers used to screen emergency scenes before response planning. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this release. Geographic coverage and image dates are mixed and not fully listed. A limitation is that the collection is class-imbalanced, online-source rights may differ from the deposit licence, and event-centred samples may not represent operational drone footage. The ZIP was not downloaded; individual labels, source permissions and classifier accuracy were not checked.
